usedFor: Stripe takes the payments, and Slack is where the team celebrates or reacts. “Customer Subscribes” in Stripe can post through “Send Message” in Slack.

bestTemplate.name: “Customer Subscribes” in Stripe, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A new subscriber is the event teams most want to see, and Stripe pushes it as it happens. “Send Interactive Message” adds buttons if someone has to act.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for your approval today. “New Customer Created” and “Customer Subscribes” are separate events, so a customer without a subscription will not trigger the post.
